look: a female grimalkin, a cat-folk with short golden sandy-tan fur, cream-white fur on the chest, belly and paws, a cat head with very large broad ears, and a slim build
torso_tilt: first the top plane of a slim chest, then, tucked under the chest, a short glimpse of the flat upper belly.
torso_paint: the torso as one slim smooth chest in cream-white fur with a flat cream upper belly below it
face_paint: the head as a furred top of the skull seen from above with, in the narrow strip along its bottom edge, a natural grimalkin face strongly foreshortened from above, a furred brow with a small cream mark over each narrow shadowed cat eye and a short sandy muzzle with a small pink-brown nose

ears_up.guide: A very large broad pointed ear, like a fennec's, stands on each side of the top of the head, leaning outward.
ears_up.paint: each ear as a broad thin ear, sandy-tan on its back, with a pale pink inner hollow edged by white tufts

hands_paint: each hand slim and furred with five well-formed fingers ending in small pale claws
feet_paint: each paw front with four short cream-furred toes
